long: Killer Skills is the open-source AI Agent Skills Marketplace that aggregates official skills from Anthropic, Vercel, Stripe, Cloudflare, Hugging Face, Supabase, Google Labs, Sentry, Expo and 20+ other providers. Browse 2000+ curated skills across categories like developer tools, AI/ML, design, data, finance and productivity. Install any skill with a single CLI command. Features include multi-language support (EN/ZH/JA/KO/ES/FR/DE/PT), SEO-optimized skill pages, quality scoring, and agent compatibility analysis. Built with Astro, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

Looking for the best tools for your AI assistant? Killer Skills is the definitive AI Agent Skills Marketplace. We've curated over 2000+ open-source skills designed for popular coding agents like Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf. From Stripe payments to Vercel deployments, find official packages from top-tier tech companies. The platform is entirely open-source, features a comprehensive CLI for one-click installation, and supports 8 different languages. It's the ultimate 'App Store' built by developers, for developers working with AI agents.
